title: Efficient and Adaptable Detection of Malicious LLM Prompts via Bootstrap Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2602.08062v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language understanding. However, they remain susceptible to malicious prompts that induce unsafe or policy-violating behavior. Existing defenses in black-box moderation APIs offer limited transparency and adapt poorly to evolving threats, while white-box approaches using large LLM judges impose prohibitive computational costs and require expensive retraining for new attacks. We present BAGEL (Bootstrap AGgregated Ensemble Layer), a modular, lightweight, and incrementally updatable framework for malicious prompt detection. BAGEL employs a bootstrap aggregation and mixture-of-experts-inspired ensemble of finetuned models, each specialized on a different attack dataset. translated_title: 基于自助聚合的高效自适应恶意LLM提示检测
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在自然语言理解方面展现了卓越的能力。然而，它们仍然容易受到恶意提示的攻击，这些提示会诱发不安全或违反政策的行为。现有的黑盒审核API防御方案透明度有限，且难以适应不断演变的威胁；而使用大型LLM裁判的白盒方法则带来高昂的计算成本，并需要针对新攻击进行昂贵的重新训练。我们提出了BAGEL（Bootstrap AGgregated Ensemble Layer，自助聚合集成层），这是一个模块化、轻量级且可增量更新的恶意提示检测框架。BAGEL采用自助聚合和受专家混合启发的微调模型集成方式，每个模型专门针对不同的攻击数据集进行训练。在推理时，BAGEL聚合从随机选择的集成成员子集中得到的预测结果，并可选择通过一个轻量级的学习型路由器进行增强，该路由器预测最适合处理该输入的成员模型。
tldr: 提出了BAGEL框架，通过自助聚合与专家混合启发的微调模型集成，以随机选择成员子集并可选配合轻量级路由器的方式，实现了高效、轻量且可增量更新的恶意LLM提示检测。
en_tdlr: BAGEL is a modular, lightweight, and incrementally updatable framework for detecting malicious LLM prompts, which uses bootstrap aggregation of finetuned expert models with stochastic member selection and an optional lightweight learned router for efficient inference.
